```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkorange") +
  labs(
    title = "Vehicle Weight and Fuel Economy",
    x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
    y = "Miles per gallon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
